PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
 • Perform deep development/enhancement of OpenStack components [Cinder, Swift, Image, Horizon & Identity and Billing (Ceilometer)]
 • Participate in product design activities which may require extensive research and analysis of OpenStack . Research problems and develop solutions for issues discovered by our Operations teams
 • Research bugs and submit bug reports to our internal teams or upstream OpenStack projects
 • Drives the execution of multiple business plans and projects for Infrastructure across client
 • Maintains and advances industry expertise and bring technical leadership Minimum Qualifications
 • Must have Experience in OpenStack development                                                                    
 • Very strong in the scripting technologies: Python and Ruby
 • Understanding of opensource and experience of working with RDBMS (MySQL), NoSQL (MongoDB), Django, Apache httpd
 • Experience working with Messaging Services like RabbitMQ
 • Experience in High Availability Architecture and Deployments (Linux HA, Pacemaker, DRBD)
 • Understanding of Linux scheduling (Cgroups), Linux networking (Namespaces, SELinux, IPtables, IP, GRE, VXLAN) and SDN technology (Open vSwitch)
 • Experience in storage configuration on Linux (LVM, iSCSI, SAN, NAS, Multipath, and etc)
 • Agile Development experience
 • knowledge of cloud and software engineering
 • knowledge or experience within infrastructure i.e. systems, database, cloud, networking, storage, compute
